mechanism: p=2 with batch*m>=4 skips R11CrossRows; DirectContinuous's guard is widened from `n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p` to `(n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p) ∨ p ≤ 2`. DirectContinuous.core is proven equal to the reference for all shapes and writes each row directly with an Array.mkEmpty output, avoiding per-output decode div/mod.
hypothesis: For p=2 rows, two direct dots with one shared row base may beat Cross's four-row P12 packing and its fixed preparation/output machinery.
proof: No new proof obligation: each edited `if` keeps both branches and their existing spec theorems; only the decidable predicate changes.

edits.old: if n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
edits.new: if (n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p) ∨ p ≤ 2 then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
